title: 1.2 Food and Nutrition Security
description: Food availability, nutrition, crop production and the fight against hunger. Easy level, 20 questions.

questions.question: What is Food security?
options: A material added to soil to supply essential plant nutrients
Measures used to reduce losses caused by insect and disease pests
A lack of reliable access to enough affordable nutritious food
A situation where all people have access to sufficient safe food
questions.correctAnswer: A situation where all people have access to sufficient safe food

A condition caused by an unbalanced or inadequate diet

The ability of a community to produce most of its own food
